items.html: Afterward, the aspect of the two thousand years of Yetzira was corrected, which are opposite ZA, called the Written Torah; therefore [that period] is called "two thousand years of Torah." And therefore in them the Torah was given to Israel. Afterward, [the period of] two thousand years of the days of the Messiah, which are the two thousand years of Beria — Ima, called the days of the Messiah. And even though Ben David comes only at their end, nevertheless all the two thousand years are called the days of the Messiah. And the reason is that every aspect of redemption is from the side of the upper Ima, called "freedom and liberty" (Deror ve-Cherin), and she is called Leah, the mother of Mashiach Ben David.
